items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: Xavier Cugat's band was the featured orchestra, and Lena Horne was the featured attraction. And she took Arnold Ross and Irving Ashby and myself. We were her trio.

ctx.x: Well, you mentioned Bugsy Siegel, and Bugsy Siegel was connected with...

Well, Bugsy Siegel was the owner. At least he was supposed to have been the owner. And Xavier Cugat's band was featured, and was it Lynn René... I've forgotten who... Was that the name of the girl in that film we looked
